transcript: Speaker A: [Hindi] Main hardware ki dukaan pe helper tha par mera sapna Dubai jaane ka tha. Mujhe English samajh aati thi par bol nahi pata tha, isliye interview mein reject ho gaya. Phir maine 'English Seekho' app download kiya aur AI coach Disha ke saath practice ki. Agli baar maine interview clear kar liya aur aaj main Dubai mein hoon. Aap bhi ₹1 ke trial se shuru karein. [I was a hardware store helper but dreamed of going to Dubai. I understood English but couldn't speak it, so I failed my interview. Then I downloaded 'English Seekho' and practiced with AI coach Disha. Next time, I cleared the interview and today I am in Dubai. You too can start with a ₹1 trial.]
on_screen_text: Hardware ki dukaan pe helper... English padhni aati hai, samajh bhi aati hai. Par bolne ki baari aati hai, zubaan atak jaati hai... English Seekho app... summary: An aspiring migrant worker fails his job interview for Dubai because he freezes when speaking English. He downloads the 'English Seekho' app, practices daily with its AI coach, and successfully passes his next interview. The ad promotes a ₹1 trial to help others achieve their dreams.
